title: Keyword Choice Group
description: A keyword a unit takes from a set of alternatives when its army is mustered (a Mark of Chaos, a Daemonic Allegiance, a detachment's CHARACTER pick). Each option is a unit's conditional_keywords entry whose choice_group is this group's id; a unit takes at most one option of a group.

detachment_id.description: The detachment whose army makes the choice; null when any army that includes the unit makes it.

mandatory.description: Whether every unit with options in this group must take one.

min_units.description: The fewest units in the army that must take an option of this group; null for no minimum.

max_units.description: The most units in the army that can take an option of this group; null for no maximum.
